# `scripts/fp/animals/`

[Index](index.md)

## `scripts/fp/animals/animals_feature.gd`

extends `FpFeature`

Dogs in the street (integration feature "animals"). Some people out on foot walk a dog on a lead: residents whose household lives with a dog (unless they are off to work) and a share of everyone else, fewer at night and in the rain. A dog household's dog keeps to the front yard of its house while nobody walks it, and a resident coming out takes it along. The dogs (dog_pack.gd) heel, stop to sniff, roam round an owner who stands still, come over to a crouching hero, bark at the hero and at people going by, flinch at blows and shouts, defend an owner the hero hits (biting: hero_hit "bite") and leap clear of cars. E pets a dog close by. Their barks, growls and whines go out on the bus (animal_called) for the audio feature. The bodies are Shiba Inus and huskies (dog_bodies.gd) with leads from the owner's hand to the collar (dog_leads.gd). Motion runs on delta * sim.speed, so pause freezes it.

## `scripts/fp/animals/dog_bodies.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The dogs' bodies: Quaternius' Shiba Inu and Husky (AP.DOG_SHIBA, AP.DOG_HUSKY), each scene under a root scaled from model units to its breed's height at the shoulder, with the scene's own AnimationPlayer playing the clips in place (the dog pack moves the root) and a DogRig on the skeleton for the tail, the head and the barks. start() loads the scenes on background threads; make() returns null until a scene is in, unless `blocking` (tests, photo shots) makes it wait. Without a scene a dog is a brown box stand-in.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `AP = preload("res://scripts/fp/asset_paths.gd")`
- `LOADS = preload("res://scripts/fp/scene_loads.gd")`
- `RIG = preload("res://scripts/fp/animals/dog_rig.gd")`
- `BREEDS = { "shiba": {"path": AP.DOG_SHIBA, "shoulder_m": 0.38}, "husky": {"path": AP.DOG_HUSKY, ...`: Each breed's scene and height at the shoulder (m). Both models share one skeleton, whose shoulder stands SHOULDER_UNITS model units high.
- `SHOULDER_UNITS = 2.35`
- `WALK_UNITS = 2.35`: Model units per second the planted paws cover at rate 1, walking and galloping.
- `GALLOP_UNITS = 7.0`
- `BLEND = 0.2`: Blend (s) from one clip into the next.
- `VIS = 3.0`: Draw distance (60 m).
- `STAND_IN_COLOR = Color(0.55, 0.36, 0.2)`

### Inner classes

- `Body`: One dog's body.

### Functions

- `func check() -> bool`: Checks the breeds' scenes exist. False (and why) when one is missing: make() then hands out stand-ins for it.
- `func start() -> void`: Starts loading every breed's scene on a background thread.
- `func finish_loads() -> void`: Waits for the loads still in flight (quitting with one running aborts it noisily).
- `func make(breed: String, size: float, parent: Node3D) -> Body`: A body of breed under parent, size times the breed's height, or null while its scene still loads. Reuses a released body of the same breed first.
- `func release(b: Body) -> void`: Takes b off the street for a later make() of the same breed.
- `func clear() -> void`: Frees the released bodies (teardown).
- `static func gait_speed(b: Body, gallop: bool) -> float`: Ground speed (u/s) b covers walking (or galloping) at clip rate 1.
- `static func play(b: Body, clip: StringName, rate: float, again: bool = false) -> void`: Plays clip on b at rate, blending from the clip before; again restarts a clip it already plays (a one-shot asked for once more).
- `static func bone_point(b: Body, k: int, fallback: Vector2) -> Vector3`: World position of bone k of b (the collar or the head), else a point up and ahead of the feet by the model's proportions (forward, up in model units).

## `scripts/fp/animals/dog_pack.gd`

extends `RefCounted`

The dogs' behaviour; the animals feature decides who has a dog and feeds in the world before every step(). A dog on its lead walks at its owner's left, stops now and then to sniff until the lead pulls it on, and is let off the lead to roam around an owner who stands still (in a park, say); a yard dog keeps to the front of its home and barks at people going by when it is the barking kind. Around the hero a friendly dog looks up and wags, trots over to a crouching hero and hops when petted; a barky one barks, a shy one backs off. Swings, blows and shouts close by make dogs flinch and bark; a dog whose owner the hero hits defends them, growling, barking and going for the hero's legs (on_bite). A car about to run a dog down makes it leap aside. Every dog plays Walk or Gallop at the rate its speed asks for, and its DogRig wags the tail, turns the head to what it watches and jerks it up with each bark.

### Constants

- `WS = preload("res://scripts/fp/world_scale.gd")`
- `BODIES = preload("res://scripts/fp/animals/dog_bodies.gd")`
- `HEEL_SIDE = 0.3 * WS.M`: Heel: beside the owner's left foot (HEEL_SIDE m out past the dog's own radius) and HEEL_BACK m back, closing the gap at HEEL_GAIN (1/s).
- `HEEL_BACK = 0.15 * WS.M`
- `HEEL_GAIN = 2.5`
- `LEAD = 1.8 * WS.M`: The lead (m): a dog on its lead further from its owner's feet is pulled along.
- `STILL = 0.15 * WS.M`: An owner slower than STILL (m/s) for UNCLIP_S lets the dog off the lead; it roams within ROAM (m) of them, a yard dog within YARD of its spot.
- `UNCLIP_S = 3.0`
- `ROAM = 6.0 * WS.M`
- `YARD = 2.4 * WS.M`
- `STROLL = 0.7 * WS.M`: Speeds (m/s), acceleration (m/s²) and turn rate (rad/s).
- `TROT = 2.0 * WS.M`
- `RUN = 4.5 * WS.M`
- `ACCEL = 6.0 * WS.M`
- `TURN = 7.0`
- `RADIUS_K = 0.42`: Collision radius and height as shares of the height at the shoulder.
- `HEIGHT_K = 1.3`
- `WALK_RATE = Vector2(0.45, 4.2)`: Clip rates: Walk from WALK_RATE.x to WALK_RATE.y times its own speed (a quick Walk stands in for the trot a small dog keeps up with its owner at), faster than that Gallop (back to Walk below WALK_BACK times the walk speed) at GALLOP_RATE.
- `WALK_BACK = 3.6`
- `GALLOP_RATE = Vector2(0.6, 2.4)`
- `NOTICE = 5.0 * WS.M`: The hero: noticed within NOTICE (m), barked at by a barky dog within BARK_AT, avoided by a shy one within SHY, kept GAP clear of; a crouching hero within GREET draws a friendly dog over.
- `BARK_AT = 3.0 * WS.M`
- `SHY = 1.4 * WS.M`
- `GAP = 0.25 * WS.M`
- `GREET = 4.0 * WS.M`
- `GREET_AT = 0.6 * WS.M`
- `BRUSH = 1.2 * WS.M`: Sprinting past closer than BRUSH (m) faster than BRUSH_MPS (m/s) startles a dog.
- `BRUSH_MPS = 3.0 * WS.M`
- `ANGRY_S = 12.0`: Defending its owner: angry for ANGRY_S (s), it goes for the hero within LUNGE (m), the jaws closing BITE_AT s into its Attack clip (played at LUNGE_RATE) on a hero within BITE_REACH (m of the head); at most BITES bites, LUNGE_COOL s apart.
- `LUNGE = 1.3 * WS.M`
- `LUNGE_RATE = 1.3`
- `BITE_AT = 0.4`
- `BITE_REACH = 0.8 * WS.M`
- `BITES = 2`
- `LUNGE_COOL = 2.0`
- `BARK_GAP = Vector2(0.32, 0.6)`: A volley's gap between barks (s) and the rest before a dog barks again on its own (s).
- `BARK_REST = Vector2(10.0, 20.0)`
- `DODGE_S = 1.2`: A car within its length plus DODGE_S seconds of travel ahead and DODGE_SIDE (m) beside its path makes a dog leap aside.
- `DODGE_SIDE = 0.6 * WS.M`
- `EYES = Vector2(1.55 * WS.M, 0.95 * WS.M)`: Where the hero's eyes are for a dog looking up at them (m), standing and crouched.
- `PERSON_R = 0.25 * WS.M`: People going by take this much room (m): a dog steps out of their way.
- `IDLES = [&"Idle", &"Idle_2", &"Idle_2_HeadLow"]`
- `ACT_CLIPS = {"hop": &"Jump_ToIdle", "lunge": &"Attack", "sniff": &"Eating"}`
- `NO_POINT = Vector3(NAN, NAN, NAN)`

### Properties

- `on_call: Callable`: Called with (dog, call) when a dog barks, growls or whines, and with (dog) when its lunge lands.
- `hero`: The world this step, set by the feature: the hero's feet and velocity, whether they are on foot (not driving, not in photo mode), open to a bite and crouched; moving cars as [pos, vel, half length, half width]; the feet of the people on foot around; the game's time scale.

### Inner classes

- `Dog`: One dog.

### Functions

- `func add(b: BODIES.Body, pos: Vector3, yaw: float) -> Dog`: A new dog with body b standing at pos facing yaw.
- `func remove(d: Dog) -> void`: Takes d off the street (the feature releases its body).
- `func to_owner(d: Dog, wid: int) -> void`: Puts d on the lead of person wid (traffic's walkers_near id); follow() tells it where they are.
- `func to_yard(d: Dog, lot: int, anchor: Vector3, box: Rect2) -> void`: Sends d to keep to the front of lot: it roams within YARD of anchor, inside box (xz).
- `func follow(d: Dog, e: Dictionary, dt: float) -> void`: The owner this frame (traffic's walkers_by_id entry: feet, facing, down, hand); dt game s since the last one gives their velocity.
- `func step(dt: float) -> void`: One step of dt game seconds for every dog.
- `func bark(d: Dog, n: int, force: bool) -> void`: Starts a volley of n barks, unless the dog is barking or barked lately (force: anyway).
- `func startle(d: Dog, src: Vector3) -> void`: Something went off at src close by (a blow, a swing, a sprint past): the dog flinches away and barks; a shy one whines instead.
- `func defend(d: Dog) -> void`: The hero hit the dog's owner: it growls and barks, and goes for the hero while they are close.
- `func pet(d: Dog) -> bool`: The hero pets the dog: it hops and wags, and a barky or shy dog warms to them. False, with a growl, while it is angry.
- `func head_of(d: Dog) -> Vector3`: The dog's head, and the ring on its collar the lead clips to (world points).
- `func collar_of(d: Dog) -> Vector3`
- `func shoulder_m(d: Dog) -> float`: Height at the shoulder (m).
- `func leads() -> Array`: [hand, collar, lead length, ground y] of every lead on, for DogLeads.

## `scripts/fp/animals/dog_rig.gd`

extends `SkeletonModifier3D`

A dog's life on top of its clip (DogBodies puts one on every dog skeleton): the tail wags (wag 0..1, faster as it grows), the head turns and tilts toward a world point (look) and jerks up with each bark (bark 1, easing back to 0 here). It turns bones about the model's own up and right axes, found once from the transforms between the skeleton and the scene root, so it does not depend on how the bones are rolled.

### Constants

- `TAIL = ["Tail1", "Tail2", "Tail3", "Tail4", "Tail5", "Tail6"]`
- `WAG_ANGLE = 0.4`: Swing of each tail bone at full wag (rad), the beat from a calm to a delighted wag (Hz) and the lag from one tail bone to the next (rad of the beat).
- `WAG_HZ = Vector2(1.5, 4.5)`
- `WAG_LAG = 0.7`
- `LOOK_YAW = 1.1`: How far the head turns and tilts toward look (rad, the neck takes NECK_SHARE of it) and how fast it follows (1/s); a point further behind than LOOK_GIVE_UP is not followed at all.
- `LOOK_UP = 0.7`
- `LOOK_DOWN = 0.3`
- `LOOK_RATE = 6.0`
- `LOOK_GIVE_UP = 1.9`
- `NECK_SHARE = 0.4`
- `HEAD_UNITS = 2.65`: The head's height in model units (the tilt toward look starts there).
- `BARK_LIFT = 0.3`: Head lift at a bark's peak (rad) and how fast a bark eases off (1/s).
- `BARK_FALL = 7.0`

### Properties

- `look`: World point to look at; NAN x for straight ahead.
- `pace: float`: Game seconds per real second (0 while the game is paused).

### Functions

- `func bind(skel: Skeleton3D, scene: Node3D) -> void`: Finds the bones and the model's axes in skeleton space (the dog faces +Z in scene, its right is -X).
- `func calm() -> void`: Back to a still tail and a straight head (a body going back to the pool).
